scores.notes: Dark tents of the camp around the white-curtained court, with the cloud resting on the tabernacle and people at everyday tasks: the encamped, not-travelling moment. Full-bleed oil, no marks.
Peter in his wrapped coat leaps from the boat while the young disciple points to Jesus by a fire on shore, net of fish alongside. White paper shows at the top and left edges (accepted).

Weary people slumped on rocks and a youth helped to his feet under rays of light fit the verse, but a large prophet with a staff stands in the right foreground as the speaker of the words. Ragged white paper on left, right and bottom edges (accepted).

Peter dives headfirst from the boat in his coat as the young disciple points to the tiny figure on shore; others haul the net. Full bleed, no marks; a net bundle on Peter's back is odd but not a fault.
Disciples coming ashore find a coal fire with fish and flatbread at centre, Jesus beside it and the boat with its net behind. Full-bleed oil, no lettering.

An old man reads an open scroll to women and children in a courtyard: a narrator reciting the genealogy, with no Obed, Jesse or David father-and-son shown. The scroll carries rows of pseudo-script lines (centre).
Men haul and set stones on the Jerusalem wall with scaffolding and tools, an older robed leader working among them. Full-bleed oil, no marks.

A youth lifts a fainting old man and a weak man leans on his staff under rays of light, but a prophet with a staff stands large at left gesturing as the speaker of the words. Full bleed, no lettering.

Hezekiah in circlet and blue robe stands before the temple with its bronze pillars and sea while servants carry sacks and jars in. Sky is left as bare paper reaching the top and right edges (accepted); no lettering.

Alice springs up in the courtroom as animal jurors and slates tumble from the box, lizard on the rail, King at the bench. Scribble lines on the slates and loose papers, and heart/diamond pips with squiggle index marks on the card creatures (lower left and centre). Painted to all edges; Alice reads only modestly oversized.

Priest bends beside the horned altar dropping the bird's crop and feathers onto the ash heap, tabernacle and onlookers behind. Ragged white paper at left, right and bottom edges (accepted); no lettering, no divine figure.
Night storm with disciples bailing a swamped boat, Jesus asleep on the cushion in the stern and other small boats nearby. Full-bleed oil, no marks.
Jesus asleep on the cushion in the stern as one disciple shakes his shoulder and another cries out, waves breaking in. White paper shows in the ragged left and right edges (accepted); no lettering.
Soldiers push a slab over the stone-ringed pit while the king presses his signet into wax on it and lords wait with their seals by torchlight. Full-bleed oil, no lettering.
Light breaks at the horizon between dark cloud and dark deep, no figure of any kind. Small slivers of white paper at the left edge on the horizon line and bottom-left corner (accepted).
Peter, net over his shoulder, grips the seated lame man's right hand to raise him before the golden gate, John and onlookers around. Hands and feet sound; full bleed, no marks.

A teacher with scrolls at his belt addresses a seated gathering in a Greek town: the author delivering his letter, with no mirror, dim reflection or face-to-face image shown. Bare paper sky at the top and ragged side edges (accepted).

Station-master with lantern answers the inspector as the train steams off and smoke rises over the fields, but the Holmes figure (centre right) is styled as the modern BBC 'Sherlock' screen Holmes - tousled dark curls, long dark coat with upturned collar and scarf - a borrowed screen look; I flag the styling and do not name an actor from the face. A signature scrawl sits in the bottom-right corner, with printed columns on the newspaper and map.

Empty radiant throne over a glassy floor with the four winged creatures covered in eyes, but John the narrator stands prominent in the centre foreground with staff and scroll, whom this verse does not call for. Pale ragged paper at left and right edges (accepted); no figure on the throne.

Egyptian chariots and horsemen charge down the seabed between towering walls of water, the army receding behind. Slight ragged white paper at the left, right and bottom-left edges (accepted); no divine figure.
Coal fire on the shore with fish and flatbread laid on it, Jesus crouched beside it as Peter and the others come ashore with the net. Full-bleed oil, no marks.
Peter clasps the lame man's right hand as he rises from a crouch in the temple court, John beside them and onlookers reacting. Limbs sound; full bleed, no lettering.

Saul shields his eyes on the road as light bursts from the sky and his companions recoil, Damascus ahead. The milestone at right carries painted letters reading 'DANASUS' with further characters beneath.
Storm wave breaks into the boat as disciples bail and haul, Jesus asleep on the cushion in the stern, small boats in the distance. Full-bleed oil, no marks.

Tall Alice argues with the pale King holding his note-book, Queen scowling, jury with slates. The King's card gown has heart pips and a clear red 'X' index letter (centre right), and a spectator holds a printed sheet (lower left). The soldier at right is a human redcoat guardsman rather than a flat card, and the Queen's black hair, small crown and white stand-up collar echo the animated film.

Holmes alone in his armchair with steepled fingers, pipe, lens and chemistry glass: the cold reasoner of the passage. Squiggle lines on the papers, a pinned notice and clock-face ticks (right side and side table). Painted to all edges; the face reads as a generic gaunt Holmes, not a screen likeness.
Saul flings his arm out from his seat with one spear in flight and another lodged in the cracked wall as David dodges, harp dropped. Full-bleed oil, no marks, no spirit figure.

Calf-headed Mock Turtle with a tear and the Gryphon rear up with forepaws raised either side of Alice on the shingle. Full bleed, no lettering; the sea behind is drawn like a transparent tank with jellyfish, odd but not contradictory.

Moses with staff and Aaron in the breastplate fill the foreground before the camp and cloud-topped tabernacle: the lawgivers are shown and no pig or any animal appears. A small plate of ruled glyph-like bars sits on Aaron's headband.

Hare with teapot, Hatter with cup, Dormouse asleep on the table and Alice pondering at the tea table under the tree. Scene fades to white paper on left, right and bottom (accepted); no lettering, hat patch is blank.
Aged Adam lies dead on a reed mat with his family kneeling and mourning, tent and mud-brick houses behind. Full-bleed oil, no marks, dignified.

David has just slung and Goliath pitches forward on his face between the armies, no gore. Goliath has two crested bronze helmets - one on his head at right and a second at his waist reading as another head (centre right).

Cheshire head hovers as Alice turns to find the smiling Queen close behind, flamingo and hedgehogs at her feet. Diamond pips on the small card men in the background (left). The Queen's black hair, small gold crown, white stand-up collar, red heart gown and heart-tipped sceptre follow the animated film's costume and prop.
Shafts of light break through dark cloud over a dark sea with no figure of any kind. Full-bleed oil, no marks.

Four soldiers crouch over a heap of garments, one holding lots in his palm, but on the hill Jesus hangs on the cross still fully dressed in robe, blue mantle and sandals while his clothing is being divided. Plaque on the cross is blank; no gore.

Priest in white linen drops the crop and feathers onto the ash heap beside the horned altar, tabernacle and laver behind. Bare paper sky at the top and ragged pale edges (accepted); no lettering, no divine figure.
Jesus calls with arm raised toward the opened tomb as the wrapped Lazarus appears in its mouth and the crowd reacts. Full bleed, no marks.

Seraphim hover with faces hidden and tongs of burning coals, but only the central one has six wings; the other three have four and bare uncovered feet, against the text. Isaiah the narrator stands centre foreground from behind. No figure of the Lord, no lettering.
Jesus stands in the stern with arm stretched over the water as the waves subside and the sky clears, disciples looking on. Pale ragged paper at left and right edges (accepted); no lettering.
Townspeople fill chests with coins and cloth and storerooms with jars, sacks and baskets: treasuries being filled, with no personified Wisdom. Full bleed, coins carry no legible marks.
Peter steps off the bow with arms out toward Jesus standing on the water, disciples watching from the boat by lantern light. Painted to all edges, no lettering.
